Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can be suspended. This card's [Opponent's Turn] effect affects all of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: I have this card in the battle area with 1 digivolution card under it. If an opponent's Digimon with 1 digivolution card under it later has 2 or more digivolution cards through digivolution or other process during their turn, can I suspend that opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash any 4 digivolution cards under your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, return 1 of their Tamers to the bottom of the deck.
[Opponent's Turn] None of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon can suspend.
